description: Defines the ThermalMfrImpl class implementing thermal management functions, including temperature thresholds, clock speeds, and temperature retrieval, interfacing with IARM bus calls.

classes.name: ThermalMfrImpl
classes.description: Implements thermal management interface, including temperature thresholds, clock speeds, and temperature readings, using IARM bus calls.

methods.name: conv
methods.description: Converts between PWRMgr_ThermalState_t and ThermalTemperature enum values.

methods.name: GetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Retrieves high and critical temperature thresholds via IARM bus call.

methods.name: SetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Sets high and critical temperature thresholds via IARM bus call.

methods.name: GetClockSpeed
methods.description: Retrieves current CPU clock speed via IARM bus call.

methods.name: SetClockSpeed
methods.description: Sets CPU clock speed via IARM bus call.

methods.name: DetemineClockSpeeds
methods.description: Searches for available CPU clock speeds via IARM bus call.

methods.name: GetTemperature
methods.description: Retrieves current SoC and WiFi temperatures and states via IARM bus call.
